column1: All identities, institutional emails, awards, issuance dates, passport versions and sync outcomes are fictional demonstration data.
Skill awards in A-P are already institutionally verified; no approval workflow is modeled.
One Record ID = one award event. Student ID is stable across rows; Skill ID identifies catalog definition, not a badge.
Badge/Stamp Code in N is derived from category M. Three stamp assets are shared across the three categories.
SYNCED means PDF issuance and blockchain verification are simulated as complete. This workbook does not register blockchain transactions.
The service must own a durable issuance ledger, versioning, transaction evidence, idempotent imports and retry queue.
On initial issuance, create a persistent Passport ID and write it back consistently for all rows of the student.
Q-T are system-managed fields. Restrict human edits in the live Google Sheet and protect service credentials.
Do not trust spreadsheet status alone for cryptographic verification; use the issuer registry and blockchain proof.
Test emails use example.org; replace only through an authorized, privacy-reviewed institutional integration.
COMPLETENESS RULE: A-M and O-Q must be populated on every record; N is a calculated stamp code.
R and S are intentionally blank for NOT SYNCED records because no synchronization/version exists yet.
T is intentionally blank where no synchronization failure occurred; it is an optional error field.
All Passport IDs, First Issued dates and sync results are synthetic test data; no real passport or blockchain transaction is claimed.
